description: Na₂MoC₃N₃Se is Pb(Zr_(1-x)Ti_x)O3-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.96 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five N and one Se atom. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. The Na-Se bond length is 2.97 Å. Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three C and three equivalent Se atoms. All Mo-C bond lengths are 2.14 Å. There is one shorter (2.51 Å) and two longer (2.54 Å) Mo-Se bond lengths. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Mo and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Mo and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.19 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to three Na and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₃C trigonal pyramids. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one C atom. Se is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three equivalent Mo atoms.
